name: Neura
summary: AI agent for consumer brands that recommends, sells and supports, remembers every shopper, and sounds like the brand on every channel.
description: AI agent for consumer brands that recommends, sells and supports, remembers every shopper, and sounds like the brand on every channel.

pricing.details: 14-day free trial on request. Official Indian-rupee prices are also published and are recorded only in the non-displayed official notes. Starter 90 €/month — 2,000 credits/month, 1 knowledge website, 500 indexed pages, 20 uploaded files, 3 seats, 1 integration. Growth 225 €/month — 6,000 credits, 3 websites, 2,500 pages, 100 files, 10 seats, 3 integrations. Scale 452 €/month — 15,000 credits, 10 websites, 10,000 pages, 500 files, 25 seats, 10 integrations. Extra credits: 1,000 for 53 €, or 5,000 for 225 €. An AI reply uses 1 credit, or 3 when the customer sends a photo, voice note or file; WhatsApp charges its own fees separately.
pricing.label: Premium

features: AI agent for consumer brands that recommends, sells and supports, in the brand’s voice, on every channel
Remembers every shopper; knowledge from websites, files and Q&A; procedures, forms and policy rules
Integrations and a human handoff inbox
Official prices in two currencies (one reference used for the euro amounts); 14-day trial on request
